 This ladies Ariat belt has a stylish western look. The black embossed strap has large alternating oval and rectangle antique silver western conchos. This belt is perfect for a night on the town.
 Sizing Guide :
 Ariat belts are measured from the end of the strap on the buckle side to the center of the middle hole. The best rule of thumb is to buy a belt 2” larger than your waist/pant size.
- Small:  30”
- Medium: 34”
- Large: 38”
- XLarge: 42”
